abstract: Firms in decentralized markets often trade using quantity contracts, agreements specifying quantity prior to the point of sale. These contracts are valuable because they provide quantity assurance, as trading frictions could prevent a buyer and seller from matching in the spot market. However, quantity contracts prevent sellers from optimally allocating production across buyers after market conditions realize. Using proprietary invoice data, we estimate a model of quantity contracts in the pulp and paper industry. The average value of a quantity contract is 10% of profits, but would be 55% larger if sellers could optimally allocate production after market conditions realize.
abstract_zh: 摘要 在分散市场中，企业常采用数量合同进行交易，即在销售前约定具体数量的协议。此类合同因能提供数量保障而具有价值——交易摩擦可能导致买卖双方在现货市场中无法匹配。然而，数量合同会阻碍卖方在市场条件实现后，将生产在买方之间进行最优配置。我们利用专有发票数据，对纸浆与造纸行业中的数量合同模型进行了估计。数量合同的平均价值相当于利润的10%，但若卖方能在市场条件实现后实现生产的最优配置，该价值将提升55%。
title: Pulp Friction: The Value of Quantity Contracts in Decentralized Markets
title_zh: 纸浆摩擦：分散市场中数量合约的价值

abstract: This study explores the high- and low-volatility spillover effects and portfolio allocation from a frequency-domain perspective across the stock, bond, forex, gold, and oil markets. Specifically, we decompose realized volatility into high- and low-volatility regimes and analyse volatility spillovers from both short- and long-term components using the TVP-VAR frequency connectedness approach. In addition, we employ four portfolio strategies to evaluate cumulative returns and hedging effectiveness. This results reveal significant differences in spillover effects between high- and low-volatility networks: short-term spillovers dominate in high-volatility networks, whereas long-term spillovers are the main contributors in low-volatility networks. Furthermore, the portfolio constructed using the minimum connectedness approach (MCoP) exhibits the highest cumulative returns, whereas the minimum variance portfolio (MVP) and risk parity portfolio (RPP) achieve stronger hedging effectiveness. Overall, this study highlights the importance of jointly considering volatility intensity and time-frequency characteristics when assessing cross-market risk transmission and designing portfolio strategies.
abstract_zh: 本研究从频域视角探讨了股票、债券、外汇、黄金及石油市场间的高、低波动溢出效应与资产配置策略。具体而言，我们将已实现波动率分解为高波动与低波动状态，并采用TVP-VAR频域关联方法，从短期与长期成分两个维度分析波动溢出效应。此外，我们运用四种投资组合策略评估累计收益与对冲有效性。研究结果显示，高波动与低波动网络中的溢出效应存在显著差异：高波动网络中短期溢出占主导地位，而低波动网络中长期溢出为主要贡献因素。进一步发现，基于最小关联法构建的投资组合（MCoP）具有最高的累计收益，而最小方差组合（MVP）与风险平价组合（RPP）则展现出更强的对冲有效性。总体而言，本研究强调了在评估跨市场风险传导与设计投资组合策略时，需同时考虑波动强度与时间-频率特征的重要性。
title: Financial market high-low volatility spillover and portfolio allocation: a time frequency analysis
title_zh: 金融市场高低波动溢出与投资组合配置：时频分析

abstract: ABSTRACT While most national statistical agencies still use chained Laspeyres indices in their national accounts, the U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis (BEA) and Statistics Canada have been at the forefront for the past two decades by using instead a superlative index—the Fisher index—when computing price and quantity indices for GDP and its components. Both agencies also publish growth decompositions in additive form. At the same time, when computing total factor productivity (TFP), Statistics Canada and, in the U.S. case, the Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) use another superlative index, the Törnqvist, which naturally comes in a multiplicative form. This is somehow as if these two exercises were totally unrelated, whereas in fact they focus on the same set of data, although from somewhat different perspectives. It is little known that the Fisher index too allows for a multiplicative decomposition. Multiplicative decompositions are in many ways much more convenient than additive ones since their elements allow for geometric growth accounting, that is, they can easily be compounded both across good prices and quantities, and through time with yearly averages obtained as geometric means. This paper therefore innovates by proposing a harmonized setting for a complete multiplicative Fisher decomposition of growth, for GDP as well as for GDI. Special attention is devoted to the measurement of trading gains, both in the primal price space and, for the very first time, in the dual quantity space. This exercise leads to a very compact, twin growth decomposition of real GDI and of the GDI price deflator. Canadian annual data for 1990–2023 as used as an illustration.
abstract_zh: 尽管大多数国家统计机构在国民账户中仍使用链式拉斯佩尔斯指数，但美国经济分析局（BEA）和加拿大统计局在过去二十年中一直处于前沿，在计算GDP及其组成部分的价格和数量指数时改用了一种超级指数——费雪指数。这两个机构还以加法形式发布增长分解。与此同时，在计算全要素生产率（TFP）时，加拿大统计局以及美国的劳工统计局（BLS）使用了另一种超级指数——托恩奎斯特指数，该指数自然以乘法形式呈现。这在某种程度上就好像这两项工作完全无关，而事实上它们关注的是同一组数据，尽管视角有所不同。鲜为人知的是，费雪指数也允许乘法分解。乘法分解在许多方面比加法分解方便得多，因为其元素允许几何增长核算，也就是说，它们可以很容易地在各商品价格和数量之间以及跨时间上进行复合，年度平均值以几何平均数获得。因此，本文的创新之处在于提出了一个协调统一的框架，用于对GDP以及GDI进行完整的乘法费雪增长分解。本文特别关注贸易收益的测度，既在原始价格空间中，也首次在对偶数量空间中进行。这项工作引出了对实际GDI和GDI价格平减指数的一种非常紧凑的双重增长分解。本文以加拿大1990—2023年的年度数据作为示例。
title: GDP and GDI Growth Accounting in the Open Economy: Multiplicative Fisher Decompositions
title_zh: 开放经济中的GDP与GDI增长核算：乘法费雪分解

abstract: We conducted two framed field economic experiments with citrus farmers in Florida, United States and soybean farmers in Argentina to investigate their willingness to coordinate pest and weed management efforts. Despite the contrast between these two agricultural contexts, we find striking behavioral commonalities. In both countries, farmers display aversion to strategic uncertainty, rely heavily on beliefs about their neighbors' actions when deciding whether to participate, and systematically underestimate the probability of successful coordination even when opportunity costs are low. These common findings across such different settings suggest that the underlying mechanisms are not context‐specific but instead reflect more general features of decision‐making under strategic interdependence, lending support to the external validity of our findings. The results highlight key psychological and economic barriers to cooperation and offer policy‐relevant insights for designing interventions to enhance participation in voluntary area‐wide pest management programs. While voluntary coordination can enhance pest management effectiveness and be pareto‐optimal, the success of the collective action depends on overcoming farmers' reluctance to participate. The evidence that farmers systematically underestimate the probability of successful coordination even when opportunity costs are low highlights a key behavioral barrier that can lead to coordination failures. Interventions that mitigate strategic uncertainty and build trust among participants—such as targeted subsidies or technical assistance—could encourage participation among farmers who would otherwise be unwilling to engage in coordinated efforts. Beyond the immediate application to pest and weed resistance management, our findings contribute to a broader understanding of cooperative behavior among farmers in the presence of strategic uncertainty.
abstract_zh: 摘要 我们与美国佛罗里达州柑橘种植户及阿根廷大豆种植户合作开展了两项框架田野经济实验，旨在探究农户参与病虫害与杂草协同治理的意愿。尽管两国农业情境存在显著差异，但研究发现惊人的行为共性：两国农户均表现出对战略不确定性的规避倾向，其参与决策高度依赖对邻居行为的信念，且即便机会成本较低时仍系统性低估协同成功的概率。这些跨情境的共性发现表明，潜在机制并非情境特异性，而是反映了战略依存条件下决策的普遍特征，从而支持了研究结论的外部有效性。研究结果揭示了阻碍合作的关键心理与经济壁垒，为设计提升自愿性区域病虫害协同治理项目参与度的干预措施提供了政策启示。尽管自愿协同能提升病虫害治理效率并实现帕累托最优，但集体行动的成功取决于能否克服农户的参与惰性。农户在机会成本较低时仍系统性低估协同成功概率的证据，凸显了导致协同失灵的关键行为障碍。通过定向补贴或技术援助等缓解战略不确定性、建立参与者信任的干预措施，可促使原本不愿参与协同行动的农户加入。除直接应用于病虫害抗性治理外，本研究还为理解战略不确定性下农户合作行为提供了更广泛的理论视角。
title: Voluntary Collective Action to Address Growing Agricultural Challenges in Two Countries: Experimental Insights and Commonalities
title_zh: 两国应对日益严峻农业挑战的自愿集体行动：实验洞见与共性

abstract: Extreme weather events generate systematic forecast errors in credit risk models. Using proprietary loan-level data covering approximately 250,000 corporate loans over 2012–2023, we find that exposure to extreme weather significantly predicts realized default rates after conditioning on model-implied probabilities. Effects are stronger for early-year exposures and reflect persistent regional vulnerability rather than transitory fluctuations. These results suggest that omitted climate risk factors contribute to systematic model miscalibration, robust across specifications. More broadly, when relevant weather events are excluded, forecast errors may become systematic rather than idiosyncratic, with implications for model design and the efficient allocation of credit.
abstract_zh: 极端天气事件会导致信用风险模型产生系统性预测误差。基于2012至2023年间约25万笔企业贷款的专有贷款级数据，本研究发现，在控制模型隐含概率后，极端天气暴露度能显著预测实际违约率。该效应在年初暴露中更为显著，且反映的是持续的区域脆弱性而非暂时性波动。这些结果表明，遗漏的气候风险因素会导致模型系统性校准偏差，且该结论在多种设定下保持稳健。更广泛而言，当相关天气事件被排除时，预测误差可能从特质性转为系统性，这对模型设计及信贷资源的有效配置具有重要启示。
title: Systematic Forecast Errors from Extreme Weather Events in Credit Risk Models
title_zh: 极端天气事件导致的信用风险模型系统性预测误差

abstract: We provide the first evidence of forward-looking reference points in investor behavior. Combining administrative data on option traders with a stacked difference-in-differences design, we show that investors' propensity to sell options spikes precisely when the underlying asset crosses the strike price, which retail investors frequently select to match their target price. The effect is difficult to explain using the standard disposition effect, nominal returns, salience, option Greeks, or complex option trading strategies. Moreover, the effect is present only for options bought out of the money, for which the strike price acts as a natural target, but absent for options bought in the money, for which it does not. The evidence is most consistent with investors evaluating gains and losses relative to a forward-looking target, in sharp contrast with the backward-looking purchase price widely used in the disposition effect literature. Our findings suggest that standard tests of reference dependence in selling decisions are misspecified when investors evaluate outcomes relative to reference points other than the purchase price.
abstract_zh: 我们首次提供了投资者行为中存在前瞻性参考点的证据。通过将期权交易者的行政数据与堆叠双重差分设计相结合，我们发现，当标的资产恰好突破行权价时，投资者出售期权的倾向会急剧上升，而散户投资者经常选择该行权价以匹配其目标价格。这一效应难以用标准的处置效应、名义收益、显著性、期权希腊字母或复杂期权交易策略来解释。此外，该效应仅存在于价外买入的期权中（此时行权价充当自然目标），而在价内买入的期权中则不存在（此时行权价不构成目标）。这一证据最符合投资者基于前瞻性目标评估损益的行为，与处置效应文献中广泛使用的后顾式买入价格形成鲜明对比。我们的发现表明，当投资者以买入价以外的参考点评估结果时，关于卖出决策中参考依赖的标准检验存在设定偏误。
title: Investment Targets as Reference Points

abstract: We study the consequences of investment fraud victimization using unique administrative data on Ponzi scheme investors. A matched control event-study design shows that the victims experience a six percent annual labor income loss. Income first declines when an investor joins the scheme, consistent with distorted beliefs lowering labor supply. The scheme’s collapse triggers a further decrease, which we attribute to financial stress. Investors also face higher indebtedness and tilt their portfolios away from delegated investments. The income loss persists in the long run, equals twice the direct investment loss, and substantially adds to the social cost of fraud.
abstract_zh: 我们利用庞氏骗局投资者的独特行政数据，研究了投资欺诈受害的经济后果。采用匹配控制事件研究设计发现，受害者每年劳动收入损失达6%。收入在投资者加入骗局时首次下降，这与扭曲信念降低劳动供给的结论一致。骗局崩溃引发进一步收入下降，我们将其归因于财务压力。投资者还面临更高的负债率，并调整投资组合减少委托投资。收入损失长期持续，相当于直接投资损失的两倍，显著增加了欺诈的社会成本。
title: Household Responses to Phantom Riches
title_zh: 家庭对虚幻财富的反应

abstract: We study consumption stimulus using digital coupons, which provide time-limited subsidies contingent on minimum spending. Analyzing a large-scale program in China, we find that the program generates large and heterogeneous short-term effects. Consumption responses vary across both consumers and locations, reflecting both demand-side and supply-side factors. This heterogeneity shapes the incidence of the program: high-response consumers tend to patronize larger businesses, leading to a regressive allocation of stimulus benefits. Through counterfactual analysis, we show that targeting rules can reshape both the size and distribution of stimulus effects. Targeting the most responsive consumers can more than double the aggregate stimulus, while a hybrid design that combines targeted distribution with direct support to small businesses improves both efficiency and equity.
abstract_zh: 我们利用数字优惠券研究消费刺激，这些优惠券提供基于最低消费额限定的限时补贴。通过分析中国一项大规模项目，我们发现该项目产生了显著且异质性的短期效应。消费反应在消费者和地区间均存在差异，这反映了需求侧与供给侧的双重因素。这种异质性塑造了项目的受益分布：高反应消费者倾向于光顾规模较大的商家，导致刺激福利的分配呈累退性。通过反事实分析，我们表明定向规则能够重塑刺激效应的规模与分布。针对最具响应性的消费者进行定向，可使总体刺激效果翻倍以上，而结合定向发放与对小企业直接支持的混合设计，则能同时提升效率与公平性。
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
title: Consumption stimulus with digital coupons: Heterogeneity and policy design
title_zh: 数字消费券的消费刺激效应：异质性与政策设计
